title: Iconography / visual directions

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Compare several visual treatments of related symbols so the chosen style expresses a deliberate brand character.
strategic_value: A consistent direction can help Verizon’s icon library remain recognizable as it grows.
demonstration: Two matrices compare icon styles. The left lists Straightforward, Playful, Simple, Illustrative and Elegant; the right compares Solid, Light, Mixed, Rounded and Light simplified.
practical_value: Evaluate a style across several meanings instead of choosing it from one successful icon.

content_islands.name: Character alternatives
content_islands.spec: Align five labelled rows of four icons at left, keeping each row’s character consistent.

content_islands.name: Rendering alternatives
content_islands.spec: Place a second five-row matrix at right, comparing weight, fill and corner treatment across related symbols.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case study links the exploration to radical simplicity and says the team selected and refined the straightforward direction.
reference_purposes.Expression: The two matrices make differences in character, fill and line treatment visible.
